blocks.html:
This method sets the active view configuration for an entity and the
authenticated user. Pass `null` as the `view_configuration_id` to clear the
active view.

types.name: entity
types.description: The entity to set the active view configuration for.

children.name: view_configuration_id
children.description: The ID of the view configuration to set as active, or `null` to clear it.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

types.name: Promise
types.description: Whether the active view configuration was set successfully.
